title: Austin Leaders' Closed-Door Appointments
summary:
*   Austin city leaders held a special evening meeting.
*   The entire session was an Executive Session, conducted behind closed doors.
*   The sole purpose of this closed meeting was to discuss appointments for various city boards and commissions.
transcript:
SPECIAL MEETING OF August 31, 1983
5:30 P.M.
Mayor Mullen called to order the Meeting of the Council scheduled for 5:30 p.m., noting
the presence of all members. Mayor Mullen announced Councfl would go Into Executive
Session for the purpose of discussing board and commission appointments, Section 2,
paragraph g, and after such closed or executive session any action to be taken shall be
done in open meeting.
Council entered'executive session at 5:55 p«m. and adjourned the Council Meeting at 6:30
p.m.
